sentences.en: The doctors wore white masks over their mouths and noses.
sentences.zh: 医生们戴着白色口罩遮住嘴巴和鼻子。

sentences.en: Donna was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
sentences.zh: 唐娜生下来就有镀银的勺子在嘴里。

sentences.en: That poor family lives from hand to mouth every month.
sentences.zh: 那个可怜的家庭每个月都靠接济生活。

senses.zh: 装腔作势说话；送进嘴里；喃喃自语
